paragraphs.text: Ezroi was a half-formed plane - or demi-plane - of the Multiverse that merged with Karudis to form Arcavios . It was a world of lumunous mana , bright and burning and inherently destructive. Various names have been used throughout literature. The Archaics named it Ezroi. Professor Kasmina used the designation "Zenith". Its sun was Ezza .

First, there was Karudis - another demi-plane. Where other planes might begin to develop life and stability, Karudis began began to develop a sibling, a twin, anchored to to the same point in the Multiverse, occupying the same impossible space. The two planes might have been to coexist forever, had not Ezroi continued to grow and spread to encompass celestial bodies of its own.

The two planes danced around each other for a time and then, inexorably, began to fall into the reality wells at the heart of their opposite number. When the worlds merged into Arcavios , their essences overlapped, but they did not overlap perfectly. The leylines of each world, the conduits of mana , overlaid with opposing elements of mana, rather than with their match, forming five paired forces called "the dichotomies": white-black, blue-red, black-green, red-white, and green-blue. Each of the dichotomies formed a small region called a " snarl ", where its effects are most apparent. The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls.
